lines.zh: 我摆尾，整片水都跟着动。
lines.en: One tail beat and the whole sea moves.
My black and white body cuts the cold water.

lines.zh: 我游得很稳，鳍几乎不摆。
lines.en: I cruise steadily, fins barely moving.

lines.zh: 背鳍划开水面，留下一道白。
lines.en: My dorsal fin splits the surface, leaving white.
I push forward under the ice.
Turning, I brake with my tail flukes.

lines.zh: 我带着身后两条一起游。
lines.en: Two others swim in my wake.
Cold water rushes past my blowhole.

lines.zh: 我浮上水面换了一口气。
lines.en: I surface and take a breath.

lines.zh: 大身体在水里比看上去轻。
lines.en: My great body is lighter than it looks.
I cut across the temperate ocean at an angle.
The sound of breaking ice carries far.
A single stroke carries me far.
The water closes over my back.

lines.zh: 我从浮冰边游过，水纹跟着我。
lines.en: I pass the ice floes and the ripples trail me.

lines.zh: 我往下潜，把光留在水面上。
lines.en: I dive and leave the light on the surface.

lines.zh: 我的鳍尖擦过一块礁石。
lines.en: My fin tip grazes a rock.
I veer around the fishing net toward deeper water.
I float and blow a column of mist.
There are small sounds under the ice.

lines.zh: 我竖起背鳍，听远处的动静。
lines.en: I raise my dorsal fin and listen far off.
My pod circles a few dozen paces away.

lines.zh: 我轻轻叫了一声，没人应。
lines.en: I call softly and no one answers.

lines.zh: 海面结着薄冰，我顶着它。
lines.en: Thin ice sheets the sea; I nudge it.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，让水流过身侧。
lines.en: I hold still and let the current pass.

lines.zh: 黑白的分界在光里很清楚。
lines.en: The line between black and white shows in the light.

lines.zh: 我把头探出水面看了一圈。
lines.en: I lift my head above the surface and look around.

lines.zh: 远处的浮冰像一块块白石头。
lines.en: The far floes look like white stones.

lines.zh: 我用回声摸索海底的形状。
lines.en: I click to map the shape of the seabed.

lines.zh: 呼吸之间，水汽散得很快。
lines.en: Between breaths the mist disperses fast.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，水面起皱。
lines.en: I snort and the surface ripples.

lines.zh: 冷了，我往暖一点的水游。
lines.en: It is cold; I drift toward warmer water.

lines.zh: 你站在冰上，我看了很久。
lines.en: You stand on the ice; I watch a long while.

lines.zh: 你这么小，也敢靠这么近。
lines.en: So small, and you come this close.
One eye stays on your boat.

lines.zh: 水里的你比岸上慢多了。
lines.en: In the water you are far slower than on land.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，我还听得见心跳。
lines.en: On shore, I still hear your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我绕着你游了一圈，没碰你。
lines.en: I circle you once without touching.
Fish scatter when I swim near.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把白斑对着你。
lines.en: I raise my head and show you my white patch.
You are neither fish nor seal.
I decide not to eat you yet.
It hurts; my hide is cut open.

lines.zh: 五十点血也经不住这样。
lines.en: Even fifty health will not take much of this.
I roll over once in the water.
The wound goes numb in the cold.
Something is biting my tail fluke.
I shake my head and blood clouds out.
I pull back to see my attacker.
That struck the base of my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，同伴听见了。
lines.en: I call out and my pod hears it.
It is not yet time for me to fall.
That meat is sinking through the water.

lines.zh: 鱼群挤成一团，正好下口。
lines.en: The fish bunch up, easy to take.
I smell blood and my appetite wakes.
Drop a fish and I will catch it.
That seal is too fat to get away.
I am not picky; any meat will do.

lines.zh: 沉船边的食物也算我的。
lines.en: Food by the wreck counts as mine too.

lines.zh: 我张嘴就能吞下这一条。
lines.en: I can swallow this one whole.
Do not carry that food away; I follow.
Hunger brings me close to your boat.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞石墙。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a stone wall.

lines.zh: 我这么大，你该早点让开。
lines.en: I am this big; you should have moved.

lines.zh: 船板碰我的背，吱了一声。
lines.en: The hull scrapes my back and groans.
Do not swim against me; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推偏了半个身。
lines.en: That shove moved me half a body off.
I slap my tail and the water pushes you away.

lines.zh: 冰被我们撞裂了一道缝。
lines.en: Between us we crack the ice.
You are so small you barely feel it.
Make way; I need to surface and breathe.
Next time I will not only bump.

lines.zh: 同类在远处回应我的叫声。
lines.en: A pod mate answers my call far off.

lines.zh: 冷水里，只有它跟得上我。
lines.en: In the cold water, only it keeps pace with me.

lines.zh: 我用头蹭了蹭它的侧腹。
lines.en: I nudge my head against its flank.
In the cold water we keep close.

lines.zh: 这一群里只有它跟得上我。
lines.en: In this pod only it keeps my pace.
We circle, tails slapping the water.
Our calls carry miles through the water.

lines.zh: 幼崽会跟着我们游很久。
lines.en: The calf will swim with us a long time.

lines.zh: 我不争，别的雄性退开了。
lines.en: I do not fight; the other males withdraw.
We head for colder sea together.
I take the dead fish drifting here.
The meat from the wreck is mine.
This carcass will feed the pod.
I carry the food along my snout.

lines.zh: 沉到水底的东西，我捞上来。
lines.en: What sinks, I bring back up.
One bite throws up a spray.
No one takes this from me.

lines.zh: 我把它推给身后的幼崽。
lines.en: I push it back to the calf behind me.

lines.zh: 这块冻了很久，硬得像木。
lines.en: This has frozen long and is hard as wood.
Scavenging costs less than hunting.
Something moves at the ice edge.
That seal is too far from the water.
Something big hides beneath the school.

lines.zh: 我听见了慌乱的划水声。
lines.en: I hear frantic splashing.

lines.zh: 冰面下那群，我挑了最小的。
lines.en: Under the ice, I pick the smallest.
My pod mate swings around the far side.
This target will feed the whole pod.
It is hurt; there is blood in the water.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那条大鱼的尾。
lines.en: I fix on the big fish's tail.
From now on it cannot escape.
I dive and come up from below.
I stop calling and go silent.
Each time it turns, I switch sides.
My pod mate has blocked the exit.

lines.zh: 我绕到它看不见的一侧。
lines.en: I slip to the side it cannot see.
I move when it comes up to breathe.
Only a sliver of my dorsal fin shows.
I drop low against the seabed.
It hesitates at the edge of the ice.
Ten more paces is close enough.
I ram my head into its ribs.
My teeth close and the bone gives.
I slap my tail and stun it.
A mist of blood bursts in the water.
I drive it down against the ice.
This bite catches only hide.
It thrashes hard; I do not let go.

lines.zh: 同伴从另一边补了一下。
lines.en: My pod mate strikes from the other side.
Between us the surface turns white.
It stops moving and I let go.

lines.zh: 我在寒冷海洋里浮上来。
lines.en: I surface in the cold ocean.

lines.zh: 四周是浮冰和灰白的天。
lines.en: Around me are floes and a grey sky.

lines.zh: 冻洋的水扎得皮肤发紧。
lines.en: The frozen ocean tightens my skin.
Two of my kind are beside me.

lines.zh: 黑白身子从冷水里冒出来。
lines.en: A black-and-white body rises out of the cold water.
A familiar call comes from far away.
There is plenty of fish here, and seals.

lines.zh: 我喷了一口气，水汽很高。
lines.en: I blow, and the mist rises high.
Under the ice it is dark; I use echoes.

lines.zh: 我们三个朝同一方向去。
lines.en: The three of us head the same way.
Hot water makes me thrash my tail.

lines.zh: 我从冰上摔进水里，砸得发懵。
lines.en: I crash from the ice into the water, dazed.

lines.zh: 我在水里也会呛，真荒唐。
lines.en: Even I can choke on water; absurd.

lines.zh: 爆开的水把我掀出水面。
lines.en: The blast throws me clear of the surface.
An arrow sticks in my back like a thorn.
Magic leaves me unable to tell direction.
Starved long, even my call is weak.

lines.zh: 雷劈在海面，我立刻下潜。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface; I dive at once.

lines.zh: 下面没有水，也没有回声。
lines.en: Below there is no water and no echo.
